propositions: Extract identity transition call graph (bind, confirm, unbind, reverse cleanup, numeric-ID re-key) from BindingStore into BindingLifecycle.py while preserving all existing behavior, pending/confirmed semantics, and immutable numeric-ID re-key rules
Every bind/confirm/unbind transition must leave at most one forward entry and one matching reverse entry via targeted single-key pops, with no ambiguity detection or abort
bind_confirm performs last-writer-wins on forward entry, popping exactly one differing old reverse key without sweep or ambiguity detection
Stale reverse entries are removed only in permitted cases: rebind (old key differs), unbind (keyed entry + orphan sweep), re-key (old key popped as new inserted), and retire (move to retired file)

note_absent_or_rekey remains on facade as coordinator; only the re-key mutation (step 4: set jira_key, reset absent_404_count, stamp updated_at, pop old reverse, insert new, save, emit binding-rekeyed) moves to BindingLifecycle.rekey

Immutable numeric-ID re-key via _current_key_by_id comparison swaps both indexes and resets absence count instead of retiring; legacy no-ID records and no-client cases degrade to note_absent without behavior change
